_comment: Profile for the Android emulator used by Stage 4d. Tuned to a 'real cheap phone' shape so perf regressions surface — a $1000 dev machine with 8 GB of emulator RAM hides issues users actually hit. The audit prefers this profile over whatever the host's default AVD is.

post_boot_settings._comment: Settings applied via `adb shell settings put` after boot. Turn off animations so render timing isn't dominated by system animation curves.

measurement_defaults._comment: Defaults consumed by run_android_perf.sh when not overridden.
